name: axp-ext-rates-g2
title: The operation rate card, the canonical operationId, links.verify, and the G2 card object
ratified: 2026-08-23 — StartupsStudio/studio#9 batch-1 founder rulings [STAKE]; placements ruled, wire members closed to the four below. 0.2.0 same day: the adversarial pricing-model survey (90 businesses; 7 EXACT / 73 STRAINED / 10 INEXPRESSIBLE) returned on the pre-authorized revise-on-friction path — the ADOPT-NOW floor (A1-A5, A7-A8, G3 meter lite) lands in §2 and every deferred amendment name is RESERVED

operationId.placement: OpenAPI operation member, passthrough on every manifest route (and collection.operationId for the branching collection)
operationId.shape: camelCase verb form: /^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$/ (decodeVin, createPlacement; embedded acronyms may stay uppercase)

rates.placement: TOP-LEVEL array of the Pricing Document (never nested under an offer)

row.operation: required — the canonical operationId, must be declared by the same manifest
row.price: scalar >= 0 | compound {fixed?, percent?, basis, cap?, floor?, min_fee?} (A1) | {passthrough: {provider, reference?, markup?: {fixed?, percent?}}} (A2) | {discovery: 'market', reference?, buyer_cap?} (A2); absent/null ONLY under non-published disclosure (A8)
row.included: A5 — qty > 0 | 'unlimited' | {qty, period: day|month|once, rollover?, at_limit?}; freeQuota stays as legacy shorthand for {qty, period:'month'} — never both
row.modifiers: A3 — [{op: multiply|add, value, scope?: rate|offer|card, condition?: {attribute, op?, value?}, stacking_order?}]
row.derived_from: A3 — operationId of another row on this card (no self-reference)
row.meter: G3 lite — {aggregation: sum|distinct|high-watermark|gauge|peak, basis?: consumed|provisioned|standing, reset_period?, definition_url?}
row.volume_breaks: A7 — {mode: graduated|retroactive|reprice-offer (REQUIRED), basis?: units|spend|instantaneous-rate, breaks: [{from, price|discount_percent}], formula_url?, approximate?}
row.estimate: A8 — {low, high, provenance?}, legal only under withheld disclosure
unreserved extra members pass through verbatim

offerMembers.allowances: A5 — [{pool_qty > 0 | 'unlimited', denomination: unit|currency, applies_to: [operationIds], conversion?: {operationId: ratio > 0}, disjunctive?, period?, rollover?, at_limit?}]

rates.freeModelRule: scalar zero prices only; no freeQuota/modifiers/volume_breaks/reference prices; nothing withheld; included.at_limit closed to block|throttle|drop

links.verify.meaning: the property's published runnable-suite export (the /verify door) — presence-when-true

g2.placement: TOP-LEVEL object on the agents.json capability card
g2.meaning: the property's G2/ICP coordinates, carried verbatim from the site manifest — presence-when-true, never authored by the generator

reserved.rule: reserved names are REFUSED by the generator until their amendment is ratified, so early adopters cannot colonize them with incompatible private conventions
